boundaries: Baseline is the release build immediately before this change, not repository HEAD; binary hashes identify each build.

Same raw corpus hash; generated per-run source directories have identical-shaped paths. Filesystem cache and OS scheduling are uncontrolled; two baseline runs show cold-start variation. Do not infer a reliable cold-start or warm-query speedup.
Logical file lengths; not allocated filesystem blocks. Online footprint includes WAL; settled data is measured after service idle exit. WAL retention is a target, not a hard limit.
Peak RSS covers Rust, not Node/browser, migrations or 24-hour residency. No million-record, real-source, other-platform or installer acceptance.
Stored candidates and projections remain distinct for reconciliation/restart; full-history in-memory facts and some traversal remain. No source log bodies persisted or user decisions removed.
